formula_review.subject: Polynomial spectral identity and finite Muon
formula_review.conclusion: Odd matrix polynomials act on the compact nonzero singular subspace. Five iterations with 3.4445/-4.7750/2.0315 are not exact matrix sign.

formula_review.subject: Promotion coefficient range
formula_review.conclusion: f(1)=1 and fprime(1)=0 give a=1.5+c and b=-0.5-2c; global nondecrease requires c in [-1.5,0.375]. Largest origin slope gives a=1.875.

formula_review.subject: Suppression and response threshold
formula_review.conclusion: Suppression coefficients 0/2.5/-1.5; sqrt(2/3) is a single-stage unstable fixed point, not the finite five-step half-response input.

formula_review.subject: Amplitude-count bound
formula_review.locations: Article derivation from initial Frobenius squared-sum budget
formula_review.conclusion: For monotone response and F(tau)=0.5, q*tau^2<=1. Counts above 0.5 do not identify exact mathematical rank.

formula_review.subject: Head norm rationale
formula_review.conclusion: Q/K norm product affects inverse temperature at fixed normalized shape; V/O norms enter output/gradient upper bounds. Neither statement proves that independent normalization preserves raw or weight norm ratios.

formula_review.subject: GRPO nondegenerate groups
formula_review.conclusion: The 1-p^g-(1-p)^g expression assumes independent identically distributed binary rewards. KL loss and other regularizers can still contribute gradients when the group-relative task advantage is zero.

formula_review.subject: Known clean-signal alignment
formula_review.conclusion: Same clean S=diag(1,0,0,0), M=G without momentum history; fixed weak-tail or dominant perturbation. Frobenius cosine compares direction, not training accuracy or stochastic gradient SNR.

results_review.subject: Reported AdamW discrepancy
results_review.conclusion: 43.6 vs32.2 at the stated Object1500-step budget; retained per table and not pooled as a matched run.

results_review.subject: FR3
results_review.conclusion: 77/90 is inferred from rounded reported values across three tasks; it is not a general-task probability or a repeated-training uncertainty estimate.

results_review.subject: RLVR
results_review.conclusion: No exact unreported curve endpoints extracted; only the specified tested Muon configurations collapse.

review: VLA launch defaults kp=0 and ns_steps=5; V/L/O route to Muon, A to DefaultPion.
finetune_pion.py force-AdamW rules include ndim<2, cls_token/reg_token, embed excluding patch_embed, lm_head, action_queries and combined action_head/fc2 names.
proprio_projector is O by name routing, and O defaults to Muon in the checked launcher.
RL Q/K/V are split along output rows; O along input columns. Qwen3-1.7B launcher uses16 queryheads and8 KVheads.
All three checked 1.7B GSM8K launchers enable KL loss and set trainer.total_epochs=15, not an explicit40-step limit.
Official VLA high_pass_ns helper casts BF16 before normalization. Probe uses CPU and distinguishes fixed epsilon from rounding.
VLA-Adapter2D scale default0.2*sqrt(max dimension); RL optimizer class defaults5*sqrt(max dimension), with head shapes used in the RL per-head helper. Scalar/matrix examples omit this scale.

limits: No VLA/RLVR training or model download performed.
CPU BF16 helper observations do not establish GPU bitwise agreement.
Constructed spectra/head blocks contain no labeled training-noise data or pretrained weights.
